A bill for an act relating to health care; requiring a health plan company to provide the same reimbursement rates for all providers; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 62Q.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[+[62Q.59] PROVIDER REIMBURSEMENT EQUITY. +]

[+If an enrollee chooses to receive a covered service from a licensed and certified advanced practice nurse practitioner or a licensed physician assistant, the health plan company must reimburse the advanced practice registered nurse or physician assistant at the same rate as a licensed physician for providing the same service. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective January 1, 2025, and applies to any covered service provided on or after that date. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to health care; requiring a health plan company to provide the same reimbursement rates for all providers; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 62Q.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[62Q.59] PROVIDER REIMBURSEMENT EQUITY.

If an enrollee chooses to receive a covered service from a licensed and certified advanced practice nurse practitioner or a licensed physician assistant, the health plan company must reimburse the advanced practice registered nurse or physician assistant at the same rate as a licensed physician for providing the same service.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective January 1, 2025, and applies to any covered service provided on or after that date.
additions: If an enrollee chooses to receive a covered service from a licensed and certified advanced practice nurse practitioner or a licensed physician assistant, the health plan company must reimburse the advanced practice registered nurse or physician assistant at the same rate as a licensed physician for providing the same service.
This section is effective January 1, 2025, and applies to any covered service provided on or after that date.
